Title: Debug env route publicly accessible
Evidence: Route file exists; no auth check; returns env info
Impact: Any caller can probe production env variable presence
Recommendation: Delete app/api/debug-env/route.ts immediately

Title: console.log leaks API key presence
Evidence: Lines 1–3: console.log('SERPAPI_KEY', !!process.env.SERPAPI_API_KEY)
Impact: Key presence info visible in Vercel logs; information disclosure
Recommendation: Remove all production console.log from route files

Title: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY name mismatch
Evidence: Code reads NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY; .env.example defines NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
Impact: If Vercel has the anon key name and not the publishable key name every server-side auth call is broken
Recommendation: Verify env var name in Vercel dashboard and align with code or rename code variable to match .env.example

Title: demo_leads table fully open RLS
Evidence: FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true); FOR SELECT USING (true)
Impact: PII (name + email) in demo_leads is publicly readable via Supabase REST anon key
Recommendation: Restrict SELECT to authenticated users or service role only

Title: Rate limiter race condition (non-atomic)
Evidence: get → check → incr pattern is not atomic
Impact: Two concurrent requests can both read count < 5 and both be permitted
Recommendation: Replace with @upstash/ratelimit (already in package.json) for atomic sliding-window

Title: No timeout on external HTTP fetches
Evidence: No AbortController or timeout parameter on fetch calls
Impact: Slow source URLs can hang Lead Finder requests up to Vercel function timeout
Recommendation: Add AbortController with 5-second timeout

Title: Wildcard image remote pattern in next.config
Evidence: remotePatterns: [{ protocol: 'https' hostname: '**' }]
Impact: Allows Next.js image optimization for any HTTPS URL — potential SSRF via image proxy
Recommendation: Restrict to known domains (Supabase storage URL)

Title: No Content Security Policy header
Evidence: No CSP headers set in middleware
Impact: XSS attacks have no CSP defense
Recommendation: Add Content-Security-Policy header in middleware or next.config headers

Title: supabase as any type casts bypass TypeScript
Evidence: supabase as any used on 3 routes
Impact: TypeScript cannot validate column names or query structure for active database operations
Recommendation: Run supabase gen types typescript and update supabase.types.ts

Title: No rate limiting on intelligence route
Evidence: Only auth check — no rate limit applied
Impact: Unlimited GPT-4o-mini calls per authenticated user; abuse would incur unbounded OpenAI cost
Recommendation: Apply same rate limiter as research routes

Title: Intelligence route AI call has no timeout
Evidence: openai.chat.completions.create with no timeout
Impact: OpenAI latency spikes can cause Vercel function timeout for end users
Recommendation: Add AbortSignal timeout to OpenAI call

Title: Inline <style> CSS not cached by browser
Evidence: Multiple const styles = backtick CSS string tags
Impact: CSS is not cached — re-sent on every navigation
Recommendation: Migrate to CSS modules or Tailwind utility classes

Title: Real-estate page is 1112 lines — single client component
Evidence: File is 1112 lines; 'use client'; all 5 forms + all 5 report renderers in one component
Impact: Entire module loads on initial visit; no lazy loading of individual report types
Recommendation: Split into lazy-loaded sub-components per report type

Title: No Redis caching for intelligence reports
Evidence: No cache.set call found; research-service.ts has Redis cache for leads
Impact: Identical feasibility inputs regenerate reports and cost OpenAI tokens each time
Recommendation: Add Upstash Redis cache layer with hash of input parameters

Title: No db index on research_requests.user_id + created_at
Evidence: No index visible in SQL; plan enforcement does a full table count per user per month
Impact: Plan enforcement query can slow as research_requests grows
Recommendation: Add composite index on (user_id created_at) to research_requests

Title: Dual schema — Prisma legacy models not dropped
Evidence: Report and ApiUsage marked as LEGACY — no active route writes to them
Impact: Confusion for new developers; plan enum diverges between Prisma and Supabase
Recommendation: Migrate historical data and drop legacy Prisma models in a planned migration

Title: Plan enum mismatch — AGENCY missing from Prisma
Evidence: Workspace.plan is enum without AGENCY; user_plans.plan allows AGENCY
Impact: A user on AGENCY plan cannot be represented in Prisma workspace model
Recommendation: Add AGENCY to Prisma Plan enum or drop Workspace.plan

Title: Workspace.ownerId has no foreign key to User.id
Evidence: ownerId String — no @relation
Impact: If owner User is deleted workspace has dangling reference
Recommendation: Add @relation to User model or add database-level FK

Title: No admin/operations API
Evidence: No admin routes for plan management user support or reporting
Impact: Operations must be done via direct Supabase dashboard — not scalable
Recommendation: Add /api/admin routes with service-role auth

Title: Legacy AI engine is dead code
Evidence: ~40 files; no active import from orchestrator.ts or any prompt file
Impact: Maintenance burden; misleading to new contributors
Recommendation: Remove orchestrator + prompts; keep OpenAIProvider class in lib/ai/

Title: research_requests.updated_at has no auto-update trigger
Evidence: No trigger to set updated_at on row change
Impact: Status updates do not reflect in updated_at timestamp
Recommendation: Add PostgreSQL trigger: updated_at = NOW() on row update

Title: Supabase types not regenerated for new tables
Evidence: Tables research_requests user_plans reports not in generated types
Impact: All supabase queries to new tables use as any bypassing type safety
Recommendation: Run: supabase gen types typescript --project-id [id] > types/supabase.types.ts

Title: No formal migration tooling
Evidence: Manual SQL scripts with no Supabase CLI migration history
Impact: No rollback capability; no migration state tracking; risk of re-applying non-idempotent migrations
Recommendation: Adopt Supabase CLI migrations (supabase db push)

Title: i18n plugin configured but not implemented
Evidence: next-intl wired up; no message files found; real-estate page uses state-based lang toggle instead
Impact: Bilingual implementation is ad-hoc and inconsistent
Recommendation: Either implement next-intl fully with message files or remove plugin and standardize on current approach

Title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML used for emoji strings
Evidence: dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: swotItem }}
Impact: Bypasses React XSS protection for that node; safe if content is controlled but creates maintenance risk
Recommendation: Replace with React component rendering; avoid dangerouslySetInnerHTML

Title: Placeholder pages have no content
Evidence: Page files exist but return empty or minimal content
Impact: Users clicking nav items see empty pages — poor UX
Recommendation: Either implement pages or hide nav links pointing to empty pages

Title: City list duplicated between real-estate page and core/data/cities.data.ts
Evidence: Two separate city lists defined
Impact: City set can diverge between modules
Recommendation: Import from core/data/cities.data.ts in real-estate page

Title: calculateCashflow has zero test coverage
Evidence: No test file for calculateCashflow; function is 117 lines of financial logic
Impact: A regression produces incorrect financial advice with no automated detection
Recommendation: Add vitest unit tests for calculateCashflow with known input→output pairs

Title: No CI to run existing tests
Evidence: No GitHub Actions workflows
Impact: Tests never run automatically — passing tests in local development provides no guarantee
Recommendation: Add GitHub Actions CI workflow running lint typecheck and vitest

Title: Intelligence route has 0% API-level test coverage
Evidence: No route test file for 1051-line primary revenue-generating endpoint
Impact: Breaking changes to primary monetizable feature are undetected
Recommendation: Add route-level tests with mocked OpenAI responses

Title: No E2E tests
Evidence: No Playwright or Cypress configuration found
Impact: Auth flows report generation and export are fully untested at integration level
Recommendation: Add Playwright E2E for critical flows: login generate report export CSV

Title: No CI/CD pipeline
Evidence: No workflow files
Impact: Every commit deploys directly to production with no automated checks
Recommendation: Add GitHub Actions with lint + typecheck + test + Vercel preview deploy

Title: No staging environment
Evidence: Single Vercel project with no preview environment separation
Impact: Development changes go directly to production
Recommendation: Create staging Supabase project + Vercel preview deployment environment

Title: No monitoring or observability
Evidence: No logging service; no error tracking; no metrics
Impact: Production errors are invisible unless Vercel log is manually checked
Recommendation: Add Axiom or BetterStack for structured logging and alerting

Title: No branch protection on main
Evidence: No observed GitHub branch protection rules
Impact: A broken commit deploys to production immediately
Recommendation: Set branch protection: require PR review + CI pass before merge to main

Title: eslint-config-next pinned to 15 while Next.js is 16
Evidence: eslint-config-next: 15.3.0
Impact: Lint rules may not cover Next.js 16-specific patterns
Recommendation: Update to eslint-config-next 16.x

Title: Vercel CLI outdated
Evidence: vercel 54.6.1; latest is 54.20.1
Impact: May miss recent Vercel features and bug fixes
Recommendation: npm i -g vercel@latest

Title: No payment integration
Evidence: No Stripe Paddle or LemonSqueezy code found anywhere in codebase
Impact: Platform cannot charge customers — revenue is $0
Recommendation: Integrate Stripe with subscription billing and plan webhook

Title: Plan assignment is fully manual
Evidence: INSERT/UPDATE only via service role; no authenticated user policy
Impact: Cannot scale; every signup requires a manual SQL insert for plan assignment
Recommendation: Add billing webhook to auto-assign plan on payment

Title: No privacy policy or terms of service
Evidence: No legal pages found in app/
Impact: Cannot legally operate a commercial SaaS product without privacy policy
Recommendation: Draft and publish privacy policy terms of service and data processing agreement

Title: No customer support mechanism
Evidence: No help chat no support email visible in UI no ticketing system
Impact: Paying customers have no support path
Recommendation: Add Intercom or Crisp chat widget; create support@eunoia email

Title: No onboarding flow
Evidence: Onboarding page exists but has no content
Impact: New users arrive at dashboard with no guidance — high churn risk
Recommendation: Create 3-step onboarding: connect profile → run first report → upgrade

Title: RE market benchmarks are hardcoded and will go stale
Evidence: City price data hardcoded in TypeScript constants with 2026 values
Impact: Reports become inaccurate as Egypt RE market changes — credibility risk for paying customers
Recommendation: Move benchmarks to configurable CMS or database table with admin update UI

Title: No analytics — usage and business metrics invisible
Evidence: No analytics integration (Mixpanel Posthog Amplitude) found
Impact: Cannot track conversion retention or feature adoption — flying blind
Recommendation: Add Posthog for product analytics (open source friendly)

Title: Resend declared but unused — no transactional email
Evidence: resend in dependencies; zero imports
Impact: No welcome email no password reset email no plan limit warning email
Recommendation: Implement transactional email using already-installed Resend package

Title: Duplicate prisma generate on build
Evidence: postinstall runs prisma generate AND vercel.json buildCommand also runs it
Impact: Wastes ~15 seconds on every Vercel build
Recommendation: Remove postinstall from package.json

Title: Unused dependencies declared
Evidence: resend installed but never imported; @upstash/ratelimit installed but manual rate limiter used
Impact: Increases bundle size and dependency attack surface
Recommendation: Remove resend (add back when implemented); use @upstash/ratelimit instead of manual

Title: Repository root cluttered with 25 markdown docs and legacy files
Evidence: api.php auth.php text.txt files; 25 audit markdown docs at root
Impact: Confusing to contributors and investors doing diligence; some files are from PHP-era predecessor
Recommendation: Move docs to /docs; delete legacy PHP and text files after verification

Title: Legacy AI engine prompts not removed
Evidence: ~40 files; orchestrator and 26 prompt files are dead code
Impact: TypeScript compiles them; they mislead contributors; adds build time
Recommendation: Delete all files except providers/openai.provider.ts and providers/base.provider.ts; move providers to lib/ai/

Title: next-intl plugin configured but no message files exist
Evidence: Plugin wired up; no messages/ directory found
Impact: Runtime error if next-intl is called without messages configured
Recommendation: Either implement fully or remove plugin from next.config.ts
